purpose: Teach: 志願/裏切り/改悪/増幅/治癒/固執/埋葬/ファシズム

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時志願兵の心理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the psychology of wartime volunteers, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Genuinely curious about his work. Gentle affirmation wrapped into the question. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治家の裏切りの事例史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on historical cases of political betrayal.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate. A slight pause before the answer, as if checking that he's understood the question correctly. Quieter confidence than correction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、改悪と批判された制度改革を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you tackled institutional reform that critics said made things worse, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful rhythm. A beat of genuine reflection in her voice. Not testing him—processing alongside him. The tone of someone thinking through something difficult.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、メディアによる情報増幅の論点を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how media amplifies and distorts information.
lines.style: Quiet precision. He's not defending his paper, just stating it. A small internal note of steadiness—he knows what he did.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統医療における自然治癒の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You researched natural healing in traditional medicine, didn't you?
lines.style: Brighter, more animated than before. Real interest lighting up. A teacher noticing threads that matter. Forward-leaning energy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政策に固執して失敗した例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at examples where rigid policy adherence led to failure.
lines.style: Steady, almost philosophical. A slight weariness underneath—he's thought about this deeply. Not rushed. The answer of someone who's sat with hard questions.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦死者の埋葬慣習史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered the history of burial practices for the war dead, didn't it?
lines.style: Slower, more solemn than her other questions. Respectful of the weight. She's acknowledging something heavy-handed about the topic itself. Quiet reverence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ファシズム台頭の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the history of fascism's rise.
lines.style: The smallest note of finality. He's answering, but there's a subtle closure at the end—maybe exhaustion, maybe just that he's said what he came to say. Steady to the last.
